title: Studio condition builder: a sharing-rule (filter-compiled) condition is not told to the builder, so list membership is written in a CEL spelling the validator prescribes as .contains there
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① defect, same class as #36381 at a fourth site · Source: fleet (L1-a REWORK 7211865092 on PR #37846, out-of-scope finding of the card thread's report 7211812962; L1 judged "file, don't drop")

## What happens

PR #37846 (Fixes #36381) makes the Studio condition builder write list membership in the spelling the validator prescribes per site (`listMembershipSource` in `@objectstack/formula`): `has(r) && r != null && V in r` for `record.`/`previous.` reads, `r != null && V in r` for a bare flow name. The validator's third arm, `S.contains(V)` where the condition compiles to a query filter (a sharing-rule condition), is never written by the builder: no host that mounts the builder tells it the mount is filter-compiled.

reach: not yet measured. The first step is to mount the builder on a sharing-rule condition, pick a list field and an "is one of" membership, save, and read what the validator answers and what the compiled filter does.

## Expected

- A filter-compiled mount tells the builder so, and the builder writes the `.contains` arm the validator prescribes there (one helper, no restated spelling), with a round-trip pin that the builder reads its own output back.
- Or, if the measurement shows the sharing-rule editor never offers list membership, close this card with that reading.

Category ①: an admin's condition is written in a spelling the validator does not prescribe for that site.
Priority: p2 — same grade as #36381; Studio authoring, not wrong data at rest. Suggested-grade: p2 · same class as #36381.
Business reason: an admin defining who a sharing rule shares records with should get a condition that compiles and saves as written; today the builder may produce a spelling the validator rewrites or refuses only on this surface.
Reader: seat repo:objectstack#3, zone `o3-build` (area:build), after PR #37846 merges (same files).
Blocked-by: #37846 (merge)
Dedupe: searched `filterCompiled sharing condition builder` (2 hits: #36381 open — the parent fix, #36167 closed) and `listMembershipCel` (0), open and closed.
Related: #36381, PR #37846, #36167.
